resume.mode: explicit --resume-from checkpoint directory into a new unused run directory
resume.abandoned_attempt_metrics: metrics after the parent checkpoint belong only to the failed attempt

checkpoint.publication: temporary directory, fsynced payloads and directory, atomic rename, verified atomic index, then auditable pruning
checkpoint.retention: latest two fully verified checkpoints; never prune the newest or only fallback

supersedes: the non-resumable local trainer checkpoint behavior only; retained historical smoke runs remain untouched
